'''H-Zeta Squadron''' was a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] unit in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was part of a [[Admiral Harkov's fleet|fleet]] under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]]. When Harkov defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the squadron defected as well. It fought the forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Battle of Ottega]], but was destroyed.
